phase0.description: Phase 0: Foundation - Repository setup and initial tracer bullet deployment

issues.title: [Tracer Bullet] Verify GitHub repository infrastructure is ready
issues.body:
## Trace Path

Verify that the repository has all required infrastructure files configured before implementation begins.

## Test Assertion

- [ ] `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` exists with at least 3 templates
- [ ] `.github/labels.yml` defines all required triage labels
- [ ] `.github/workflows/` contains CI workflow
- [ ] Labels match the triage state machine from skill

## Implementation Scope

1. Create `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/01-project-setup.md` with setup template
2. Create `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/02-tracer-bullet.md` with tracer bullet template
3. Create `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/03-feature.md` with feature template
4. Create `.github/labels.yml` with triage state machine labels
5. Create `.github/workflows/ci.yml` with minimal CI pipeline

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All templates validate against markdown lint
- [ ] All required labels defined
- [ ] CI workflow runs without errors

## Out of Scope

- Detailed feature implementation
- Complex workflows
- Multi-stage pipelines

issues.title: [Tracer Bullet] Verify Docker compose stack starts successfully
issues.body:
## Trace Path

Create minimal docker-compose.yml that starts successfully and validates basic infrastructure.

## Test Assertion

Running `docker compose up` completes without errors and shows expected container status.

## Implementation Scope

1. Create minimal `docker-compose.yml` with:
   - postgres service (port 5432)
   - Volume for data persistence
   - Healthcheck on postgres
2. Create minimal `.env` example with required variables
3. Add `docker/` directory structure
4. Verify startup with `docker compose config`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docker compose config -q` validates successfully
- [ ] `docker compose up -d` starts all services
- [ ] `docker compose ps` shows healthy postgres

## Out of Scope

- Full NTTS stack implementation
- All upstream services
- Complex networking

issues.title: [Tracer Bullet] Implement minimal issue triage workflow
issues.body:
## Trace Path

Implement minimal triage workflow using GitHub labels.

## Test Assertion

New issues automatically receive `status/needs-triage` label.

## Implementation Scope

1. Create `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/config.yml` with default template
2. Add issue template selector
3. Configure label automation
4. Test with sample issue

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] New issue created with template
- [ ] Issue receives `status/needs-triage` label
- [ ] Template fields capture required information

## Out of Scope

- Complex triage automation
- Multiple template routing

issues.title: [Tracer Bullet] Create initial PRD tracking issue
issues.body:
## Problem Statement

PRD exists as markdown file but needs to be tracked in GitHub issues.

## Solution

Break PRD into implementable issues using tracer-bullet approach.

## Implementation Scope

1. Read `PRD.md` completely
2. Identify Phase 0 foundational items
3. Create issues for each tracer bullet
4. Apply appropriate labels

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] PRD sections mapped to issues
- [ ] Each issue has clear acceptance criteria
- [ ] Issues follow tdd skill workflow

## Out of Scope

- Implementing features from PRD
- Creating detailed test plans

issues.title: [Tracer Bullet] Verify repository labels match triage state machine
issues.body:
## Trace Path

Compare repository labels against triage state machine definitions.

## Test Assertion

All required labels exist with correct colors and descriptions.

## Implementation Scope

1. Define state labels: `status/needs-triage`, `status/needs-info`, `status/ready-for-agent`, `status/ready-for-human`, `status/wontfix`
2. Define type labels: `type/setup`, `type/feature`, `type/bug`, `type/test`, `type/refactor`, `type/documentation`, `type/tracer-bullet`
3. Define priority labels: `priority/critical`, `priority/high`, `priority/medium`, `priority/low`
4. Define scope labels: `scope/backend`, `scope/frontend`, `scope/cli`, `scope/infrastructure`, `scope/testing`, `scope/docs`, `scope/adr`, `scope/migration`, `scope/security`, `scope/performance`, `scope/compatibility`, `scope/monitoring`

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] State labels match triage skill definition
- [ ] Type labels cover all categories
- [ ] Priority labels defined
- [ ] Scope labels defined

## Out of Scope

- Dynamic label creation
- Label synchronization workflows
